copy.headline: Every capital project, one system of record
copy.subhead: Owners, builders and inspectors working from the same file.

plate_direction: A wide steel and glass transit hall under construction, photographed straight down its length in cool overcast daylight. Exposed structural steel ribs recede toward a bright opening at the far end. The upper third is an unbroken pale expanse of diffused light with no structure, cables or detail in it at all. Cool grey-blue tones, documentary architectural photography, no people, no vehicles, no signage, no banners, no equipment logos.
